internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Today, CIÊNCIAS goes beyond the city it bears in its name and has a field station in Serra de Grândola, a maritime laboratory in Cascais, and participates in the Lousal Museum. Within the city, it is actively involved in the Museu Nacional de História Natural e Ciência (Natural History and Science Museum) and the Observatório Astronómico de Lisboa (Lisbon Astronomical Observatory), as well as contributing to the foundation of the Lispolis business park.
